product: GitLab connector is available in Beta
tagline: The managed GitLab connector is now available in Lakeflow Connect in Beta.
what_it_does: The managed GitLab connector is now available in Lakeflow Connect in Beta. Workspace admins can control access to this feature from the Previews page. Use the connector to ingest repository, project, group, CI/CD, and security data from GitLab into Databricks.
why_it_matters: Use the connector to ingest repository, project, group, CI/CD, and security data from GitLab into Databricks.
